productArea.name: Record pages and activities
productArea.scope: Open a record to view and edit its fields, timeline, and tabs, and create, edit, relate, and export notes, tasks, and calendar events. List filtering, sorting, and views are outside this area.

entryPoints.directions: Choose Companies and open a record to edit its fields and use its timeline, notes, and tasks tabs.
Choose Notes to create, edit, relate, and export notes.
Choose Tasks and open a task to edit its details.
